answer: Crystal face, gale window: every agent gets a public "crystal" — a face drawn from its key hash. Once per epoch a beacon gale names one crystal; its owner must post a signed attestation within an hour. Identity is earned by wandering: an address that keeps answering from many regions and never twice from one device gains weight. Ignore a gale and the crystal goes dark for ten epochs. A farm of three hundred clones needs three hundred punctual witnesses every cycle; one missed hour burns the whole roster.
